about_the_game:
Experience the refined sounds of the new Legend of Mana soundtrack.

Legend of Mana Remastered: The Soundtrack, featuring tracks renewed specifically for the remastered version of Legend of Mana, is now available for download!

This soundtrack includes 54 tracks, all rearranged and remastered under the supervision of the original composer, Yoko Shimomura. While preserving the charm of the original compositions, you can enjoy from the gorgeous and resonant map themes to the powerful boss tracks performed by a band.

Enjoy the richer and deeper sound of Legend of Mana.

*This information is based on the CD release in June 2021.
